integrity: Irreducibility is proved independently by parity-dependent Eisenstein arguments. The published theorem is used only after its hypotheses are checked explicitly; the exact iff reduction is to squarefreeness of \(c\) and \(c+1\).
scientific_limitations: The monogeneity step uses Theorem 1.8 of arXiv:2610.02111v1. The classification is restricted to positive \(c\) with \(c\equiv2\pmod4\); no statement is made for other residue classes. Finite verification is corroborative only.
title: Alternating Eisenstein classification for a quadratic composite tower
